# 1,000.00 USD of income paid into A at 1.40, taking it from −500.00 to
# +500.00, with no split giving the owed cost basis the first 500.00 repays.
#
# Repaying a debt draws its cost basis down, and which one decides the
# difference realized, so the split is refused as every disposal that gives no
# guid is.
#
# Imported into the book usd_moved_out_of_an_empty_account.txt makes.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_past_zero_has_a_cost_basis_on_the_other_side.py.
